title: Levuvo SF feature plan (B2, GB2.1, GB3.2)
description: Source of features/<ID>/PLAN.md (rendered by the factory). Written by the planner through tools; 'done' flags are set by the factory when the builder completes a task. The factory additionally checks that every AC of the spec version is covered by a task (GB2.1), that AC IDs exist in that version, and that the last task is the docs task. write_plan accepts only tasks with done: false; only complete_task (B3) sets done: true. In re-plan mode the factory carries the done state over for tasks unchanged from the previous plan version; new and changed tasks start open.

version.description: Plan version, set by the factory; a re-plan (impact extension) creates a new version, the hidden scenarios stay valid (they depend on the spec only).

report_id.description: Part C: a re-plan for a fix (C3) when the report's affected paths are not enough.

tasks.description: Ordered. Size to the feature: a small feature is one task plus the docs task.

kind.description: build = tests first, then code; docs = README, usage, API description, ADR if needed.

notes.description: Approach in a few lines, no code.

paths.description: Files or glob patterns the builder may change (GB3.2), incl. tests and docs.

other_features.description: Features whose code is touched. Changing their spec or an approved ADR is a question, not a plan (R2).
